newsitem.title: JAPAN: U.S. Treasuries inch down in Tokyo after NY rises.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasuries inch down in Tokyo after NY rises.

text.p: *U.S. Treasuries inched down by Tokyo midday on light position-adjustment sales following rises in New York overnight.
*Market undertone remained bullish on brighter technical climate.
*Speculation that Friday's non-farm payroll would be smaller also provide additional price support.
